title: Fuso Shogun Fups compatable Custon Built Bullbar #3
description: Fuso Shogun heavy duty hi-tensile polished aluminium FUPS Bullbar with box uprights. Contoured extra deep main channel. Combination LED indicator/parking lights in outer uprights. Headlight protection grills. Dual driving light mounts plus special Light Bar mount centre tube. Heavy duty hi-tensile aluminium backing plate (same strength as steel) with 35mm tow pin.
